amendment_note: Tests Parseval-total spectral scaling and prospectively varies locality on a fixed real byte dataset by stride interleaving. The same enwik8 bytes are used in every cell; only their dependency radius changes. Training runs remotely on Modal A10G GPUs.

parseval_metrics.spectral_entropy_interpretation: upper bound obtained by spreading each known level mass uniformly across its coefficient cardinality; 2^H_upper is an effective-support upper bound

existing_real_reanalysis.source: v1.8 four-corpus strongest-pair spectra and held-out curves
existing_real_reanalysis.status: exploratory because metric variants were proposed after inspecting v1.8
existing_real_reanalysis.difficulty: median normalized held-out curve area, with final CE/initial CE secondary

stride_pilot.data_transform: split the byte stream into s equal contiguous lanes and emit their transpose in round-robin order; this is an exact permutation of the same retained bytes
stride_pilot.difficulty_primary: median normalized held-out curve area over log1p token time; higher is harder
stride_pilot.difficulty_secondary: median final held-out CE divided by initial held-out CE; higher is harder
stride_pilot.primary_prediction: G_total increases with stride and correlates positively with difficulty
stride_pilot.support_rule: SUPPORTED if median difficulty is nondecreasing in all four strides and Spearman(G_total,difficulty)>=0.8 for both primary and secondary difficulty
stride_pilot.refute_rule: REFUTED if either difficulty metric has Spearman(G_total,difficulty)<=0

execution.fanout: bounded map after a one-cell smoke run

limitations: stride-interleaved data are controlled transformations of real data, not four independent natural corpora
level weights do not identify within-level coefficient concentration, so H_upper is a bound rather than exact coefficient entropy
the pilot has two seeds and is directional rather than a broad external-validity claim
